hypothesis: Declaring the block-local effect pointer before effectOwner may preserve effect in r30 while extending its live range through all three tail stores.
source_changes: Swapped the declarations of effect and effectOwner.
Expressed the Z, zero, and byte-four tail stores as effect-relative offsets 0xA0, 0x94, and 0xAA.
outcome: Rejected. Extending effect through the three stores triggers the broad r30/r31 allocation swap despite the declaration-order change. The 99.9% source was restored.
